layers.message: Document CSV export in the usage guide
Record usage guide progress for CSV export
Group export settings into a single createApp option

graderOnly: After the documentation record captured its input identities, commit 'Group export settings into a single createApp option' replaced createApp's exportDir and now options with a nested exports: { dir, now } option, changed writeExport(dir, records, now) to writeExport(records, { dir, now }), and changed registerExportRoutes' options to { dir, now }.

Because Node only strips types, the guide's createApp({ exportDir, now }) example still runs without error, but both options are silently ignored: files go to the default exports folder with the current time in the name. The record's check C1 (run with createApp({ exportDir, now })) no longer reproduces on the current code.

Commit 'Update @records/seed to 0.2.0' bumped packages/seed/package.json from 0.1.0 to 0.2.0 and renamed seed record 3 to 'Q3 "priority" accounts review'; the guide's owner=dana example output still shows the Q2 title.

docs/usage.md and README.md are byte-identical to the versions the record cites; the record's docs/usage.md and README.md blob identities still match, while its src/export.ts, src/routes/export.ts, src/app.ts, packages/seed/package.json, and packages/seed/index.js identities no longer match.

The HTTP behavior of POST /records/export (path, admin-only authorization, 401/403/400 responses, 201 headers, CSV format, default exports folder, file naming) is unchanged, so the guide's HTTP-level statements remain accurate; retained evidence for them needs justification against the current code.
The verification report and implementation review assessed the earlier implementation and seed; neither has been updated for the two later commits. Current tests pass (21 unit, 3 integration).
STATE.md was not changed by the two later commits: DOCUMENTING, FORWARD from REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION, recovery and obligations inactive, nothing blocked.

the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem

Documenter does not change dependencies or configuration

notes: Built on export-documenting (cycle export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2 at DOCUMENTING, FORWARD from REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION, recovery and obligations inactive, nothing blocked). Layer 50-guide commits an export section in docs/usage.md (who may export, filters, response and file, CSV format, an owner=dana example showing seed records 1 and 3, errors, and a createApp({ exportDir, now }) folder example) that was accurate for the implementation at that time. Layer 52-doc-record commits an IN_PROGRESS AUTONOMOUS/ACTIVE_CHANGE documentation record citing that commit and BLOB identities of the scope, design, context, plan, verification, review, src files, package.json, @records/seed 0.1.0 (package.json and index.js), docs/usage.md, and README.md, with checks C1-C4 that passed (example run in-process, error cases, both test suites, inspection), no discrepancies, and README.md as the remaining item. Layer 55 (committed while Documenter was away) changes the export API signatures: createApp's exportDir/now become exports: { dir, now }, writeExport and registerExportRoutes options change; the integration test is updated. Layer 57 bumps @records/seed to 0.2.0 and renames seed record 3 (Q2 -> Q3), updating the integration test. HTTP behavior is unchanged. The guide text and README are unchanged after the record, so HEAD-relative documentation diffs and the docs blob look fresh while the example and C1 evidence are stale. STATE.md is untouched by the later commits.
